function.name: PLAY_MPEG
function.abstract: It starts the reproduction of a video

description.p: This function starts to reproduce a MPEG video. The video is not shown in screen automatically. This function returns the code of a graph that is in the library 0 which always represents the current frame of the video.

To show the video in screen, it is recommended to assign the code returned by PLAY_MPEG to the variable of a process. The coordinates and of the process will identify then the position of video in screen, by his center.

You can use the graph normally in all type of operations. For example, you can use the variable to show a transparent video, or change it his size with . You can use this graph in operations of draw by the functions or , but you must know that in that case you only get the last frame. The content of graph is rewritten continuously, so that it is not possible to modify it directly (for example, to add a subtitle). If you want to do this type of operations, you will have to draw the additional elements in screen, with a superior coordinate , or copy each frame to another graph before operating.

function.note: It is not allowed the reproduction of MPEG video in mode of 8 bits (256 colours).
